PreInvocation.command: if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook agy pre_invocation; else [ -z "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && eval $(ps eww -p $PPID 2>/dev/null | tr " " "\n" | grep -E "^TAKO_(SOCKET|SURFACE_ID)="); export TAKO_SOCKET TAKO_SURFACE_ID; if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set working --text "Thinking..." >/dev/null 2>&1; takoctl progress indeterminate >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; echo "{}"; fi; :

Stop.command: if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook agy stop; else [ -z "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && eval $(ps eww -p $PPID 2>/dev/null | tr " " "\n" | grep -E "^TAKO_(SOCKET|SURFACE_ID)="); export TAKO_SOCKET TAKO_SURFACE_ID; if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set idle >/dev/null 2>&1; takoctl progress clear >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; echo "{}"; fi; :
